Pricing [...] Clocknext is a billing and monetization platform built for AI-native companies and SaaS teams that develop and sell AI agent products. It is deployed as a cloud-based solution with a drop-in SDK and API, requiring no on-premises setup. Product, engineering, and revenue teams use Clocknext to manage pricing, metering, and invoicing for agentic applications without building or maintaining those systems in-house. Core features include credits and wallets for token-denominated usage, automated usage metering, outcome-based pricing that bills for agent-delivered results rather than raw compute, and composite pricing that bundles credits, outcomes, and units into a single line item.
